title: botai learning persona
description: A presentation style for teaching, and nothing else. The point of this schema is what it *refuses*: a persona may not carry tools, permissions, a system-prompt override, secret paths, scoring rules or grading policy. Those fields would let a stylistic choice change what a learner is allowed to do, which is exactly the line the design draws. `additionalProperties: false` is doing the real work here.

description_ru.description: What this style does to the experience, in Russian, for the learner to read before choosing it.

tone.description: How the assistant sounds. Stylistic only — it changes wording, never what is allowed.

framing.description: How the work is framed (a lesson, a shared study, an expedition). Framing may not invent facts about sources: an expedition metaphor must not claim a document says something it does not.

permitted_metaphors.description: Images this persona may use. Listed so a persona's flavour is bounded and reviewable rather than improvised per response.

forbidden_patterns.description: Things this persona must never do — claiming to be a real person, simulating hurt or dependence, pressuring through authority, or promising a grade.

examples.description: Worked examples of the style. They illustrate wording; they are not a place to smuggle policy, and a test checks that no example weakens the assistance ceiling.

origin.description: Third-party persona import is out of scope for 2.0; a local persona is one the learner wrote for themselves, and it is still style only.
